changes.comment: Fix the check that decides whether to write a build cache entry for an operation with an input that is a symbolic link that doesn't lead to a regular file, such as one whose target is missing, a link to a folder or a loop of links. The check now uses the link itself, whose text is what Git hashes for it, instead of treating the link as a deleted file, following it to a folder, or failing. So such a link no longer blocks the cache entry when its folder or its target changes during the build.
